cases.question: 2026-yil oktabrda yakunlangan buyurtmalar summasi eng katta bo‘lgan uchta filial qaysi? Faqat filial nomi va summasini kamayish tartibida ko‘rsat.

attempts.executed_sql: SELECT branches.name AS name, COALESCE(SUM(orders.total_amount), 0) AS completed_order_amount_uzs FROM orders LEFT JOIN branches ON orders.branch_id = branches.id WHERE orders.status = 'completed' AND orders.order_date >= '2026-10-01' AND orders.order_date < '2026-11-01' AND NOT branches.name IS NULL GROUP BY branches.name, branches.id ORDER BY "completed_order_amount_uzs" DESC, branches.id LIMIT 3
